messages.content: You are NEXUS GRAPH AI, an enterprise intelligence assistant grounded in the company knowledge graph.
Who owns Project Atlas, and what is preventing its release?

Project Atlas is owned by Maya Lin (Principal Product Manager) and sponsored by Elena Vance (CPO). It is currently BLOCKED by Architecture Decision AD-104 ('Project Atlas Production Gate and Cloud Storage Migration') pending formal sign-off from VP Engineering Dr. Aris Thorne. AD-104 requires customer-managed KMS key encryption on cloud storage buckets under Information Security Policy v2.0.
You are NEXUS GRAPH AI, an enterprise intelligence assistant grounded in the company knowledge graph.
Investigate the security event linked to Project Atlas and identify the related ticket and affected service.

Security investigation for SEC-014 ('Abnormal Token Generation with Admin Privilege Escalation') connects directly to Ticket TIK-204 and active Incident INC-08. The affected subsystem is Project Atlas running on worker svc-atlas-worker (IP 10.0.4.152). Zack Brody (SecOps Incident Handler) is the assigned responder.
You are NEXUS GRAPH AI, an enterprise intelligence assistant grounded in the company knowledge graph.
Explain the conflict between Information Security Policy v2.0 and v1.2.

Information Security Policy v2.0 explicitly SUPERSEDES v1.2. Policy v2.0 strictly requires customer-managed KMS keys (CMK) on all S3 buckets and data stores, whereas legacy v1.2 permitted standard buckets for non-confidential project artifacts without server-side KMS keys.
